_why: The measured failure profile of B19 arm B (appendix 32.109): 30 'no stub path at VIA', 30 'the legs clear
no smoothing of the centreline', 8 'no room for the layer-change via pair', 6 'no via site at U3/U4'.
32 of all failures die at a via rather than a pad. These arms attack those two classes, each one knob at a
time plus four deliberate pairings, against a baseline of 53 of 113 on placed board fc27d67c.
Predictions are what I actually expect, not what is safe: an arm that cannot miss teaches nothing.

predict.basis: the measured baseline on this placed board; if it does not reproduce, nothing below means anything
measured at 56 in 32.109; this arm re-proves it beside the others
the leg test targets the 30 'legs clear no smoothing'; +4 of 30 would be a poor yield and is the floor I will accept as a signal
32.95 measured the escape-via entry at about +27 on B17 as a global mode; it targets the 30 'no stub path at via' directly
the two classes are disjoint in the profile, so their gains should add
12 candidates was never measured; a wider sweep should recover ends the leg test rejects
the same, further; if 60 is no better than 30 the sweep is not the limit
0.12 beat 0.05, 0.15 and 0.18 on the old placement; 0.08 was never tried and this placement is not that one
0.15 measured 49 against 0.12's 49 on the old placement; I expect no gain and am recording that
the slim retry is what a SLIM line reports; a tighter one should recover pairs that fail the first search
a 40 mm box measured 45 against 25's 49 on the old placement; I expect it to cost, and an arm I expect to lose is worth one slot
the escape-chain strip is 6 mm; the failures concentrate at the fine-pitch parts' escape clouds, which are 4 to 8 mm deep
only 4 of 53 failures are expansion-capped, so doubling the budget should buy about that and no more
32.98 says thirteen of the first twenty four failures were the staircase refusal; turning it off should cost roughly that, which measures what it is worth
every lever that helped, together; this is the arm that says whether they compose
the via entry plus a tighter slim retry, the two that act at the fine-pitch ends
